newsitem.title: USA: Chile's Garcia warns against U.S. protectionism.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Garcia warns against U.S. protectionism.

text.p: Chilean Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia, in Washington to defend his country's salmon industry from dumping charges, said Friday that protectionist trends in the United States may threaten the expansion of free trade in the Americas.

"We are worried that these accusations will strengthen the risk that protectionist groups will obstruct the advance of trade liberalization to which our countries are committed," Garcia told a news conference before returning home.
Garcia, however, the Clinton administration is determined to obtain free trade negotiation from Congress this year.
